newsitem.title: USA: Signet Banking Q1 shr $0.54 vs $0.52.
newsitem.headline: Signet Banking Q1 shr $0.54 vs $0.52.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
Note: Managed loans totaled $7.3 billion at March 31, 1997, compared with $6.8 billion one year earlier and $7.4 billion on December 31, 1996.

Note: During the 1997 first quarter, the company sold $165 million of adjustable rate mortgage loans and its $76 million portfolio of loan-by-check risk test receivables. Adjusting for these sales, the annualized growth rate in managed loans was 5 percent for the first quarter of 1997.

Note: Non-performing assets at March 31, 1997, amounted to $40.7 million, or .65 percent of loans and foreclosed properties. Non-performing assets totaled $47.2 million at March 31, 1996, and $38.8 million at December 31, 1996.

Note: The provision for loan losses was $16.4 million for the first quarter. At March 31, 1997, the loan loss allowance of $121.2 million equaled 450 percent of non-performing loans and 1.95 percent of loans outstanding.
